project: Namias Portfolio - Projects Section Revamp v4
summary: Complete overhaul of the Projects section. Home page shows 4 recent projects with 'View All' link. /projects page shows all projects in 2x2 grid with All/Live/Showcase tabs. Showcase projects get /projects/[slug] detail pages. Feature-flagged with IS_PROJECTS_REVAMP_ENABLED.

designReference.description: Dark cards with bold project name, one-line description, and URL code box. No images on cards. Clean, minimal, scannable.

principles: Commit-per-slice: every change gets its own commit
Home page is a teaser: 4 recent projects + View All link
No images on cards: project name, description, URL only
Three tabs on /projects: All / Live / Showcase
Accessible: keyboard nav, focus rings, reduced-motion

commitPlan.strategy: One commit per logical slice. Each commit is self-contained and passes all checks.
